Reviewer: MacBook-Pro.local pool job skull-review-4374, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.** One requested change. It is small: remove a personal file path from the new bench row. The instrumentation is good, and all of the suites below pass.

Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4374#issuecomment-7219732487

## What looks good

- The timings are logging only. I read each hunk. No hunk changes a control path, a refusal or a returned value. `deviation.largest()` is a plain getter (`crates/kernel/src/mesh_deviation.rs:71`). The `Ok(solid) => { ...; out.solids.push(solid) }` arm keeps the same result.
- The stage names (`parse`, `topology`, `build`, `mesh_plan`, `mesh_deviation`, `facets`, `weld`) are stable and agree with the profile table in the body.
- The new bench row is `#[ignore]`d, pins nothing, and passes when the file is not there. I ran it: `rotor: skipped (no repro file ...)`, 1 passed.
- `tracing` is already a workspace dependency (root `Cargo.toml:38`), and `camcraft-geometry` already uses it. `Cargo.lock` adds two edges and no new package. There is no new `camcraft-*` edge, so no `docs/decisions/` entry is necessary. No new third-party code is built, so I built this PR locally.
- The profile in the body and on #4200 is useful. It shows that our own `mesh_deviation` is the largest stage, and that the 0.005 mm attempt before the loose-chord path costs about 240 s.

## Safety tier

The diff touches the STEP read (`crates/kernel/src/solidcore_step.rs`), the machining mesh (`crates/kernel/src/machining_mesh.rs`) and the geometry import loop (`crates/geometry/src/step.rs`). It adds only `tracing::info!` events and `Instant` reads. It changes no geometry, no verdict, no posted G-code and no stock simulation. The PR has no mutations and moves no goldens. Thus I ran no mutations. Instead, I ran every kernel and geometry suite and the app STEP suites to show that the verdicts are unchanged.

## Results (locally, trial merge with upstream/main 52d5ff6dc)

The trial merge is clean. The quick plan maps to 1230 steps because `Cargo.lock` changed. I ran the suites that the diff reaches:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel`: all 27 binaries pass. This includes lib 22, `machining_mesh` 7, `machining_mesh_bounds` 5, `machining_mesh_open` 6, `machining_mesh_parity` 7, `machining_mesh_redivide` 1, `machining_mesh_shortfalls` 3 (1 ignored), `step_agreement` 32, `step_import` 3, `step_edge_gap` 6, `step_twisted_flank` 3, `corrupt_input` 6 and `solidcraft_import` 13. 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test mesh_deviation_bench rotor_step_profile_bench -- --ignored`: 1 passed (skip path).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry`: all binaries pass. This includes lib 77, `step_twisted_flank` 2, `step_edge_gap` 4, `step_metre_unit` 1, `step_units` 6, `step_diag` 5 and `step_csys_read` 11. 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-kernel -p camcraft-geometry --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test step_agreement`: 32 passed.
- kernel `machining_mesh` suite: 7 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join`: 5 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test import_step_guard_default_cap --test import_step_open_shell --test step_nesting`: 1, 4 and 9 passed.

I did not run the heavy lanes. No heavy record names this head. The diff adds no heavy logic and only one ignored row that skips without its file.

## Requested before merge

1. `crates/kernel/tests/mesh_deviation_bench.rs:176` (`rotor_step_profile_bench`): the default path is `C:\Users\tbras\Documents\Rotor\Rotor.STEP`. This puts a person's account name from their own machine into the public source tree. It is also a Windows path in a test that must run on all three systems (AGENTS.md "Stays buildable everywhere"). Remove the default. When `CAMCRAFT_ROTOR_STEP` is not set, print `rotor: skipped (set CAMCRAFT_ROTOR_STEP)` and return. For example: `let Ok(path) = std::env::var("CAMCRAFT_ROTOR_STEP") else { println!(...); return; };`. Also change the doc comment above the row ("defaults to the reporter's path").

## Optional, non-blocking

- Log level. The app's `DEFAULT_FILTER` is `info` (`crates/app/src/logging.rs:41`, "Quiet by default"). With this PR, each STEP import in the app writes about 11 parse progress lines, and the stage lines for each solid and each mesh attempt, to stderr and the log. Think about `tracing::debug!` for the progress and stage lines. The bench can then set `camcraft_kernel=debug` in its own filter. If you want the lines at `info` for reporters, that is acceptable too. Then say so in the body.
- `crates/kernel/src/solidcore_step.rs:114-123`: the `thread_local!` key is `stage.len()`. Two stage names of the same length share one key. The name itself (`&'static str`) is a safer key.
- `crates/kernel/src/machining_mesh.rs` goes from 395 to 407 lines, past the 400-line limit. Not blocking here. The #4200 fix can split the planner loop out.
- `crates/kernel/Cargo.toml:20`: the comment cites #163. #163 is the logging seam. #4200 is the reason for this edge, so name it too.

## Process

- The commit subject is conventional. The body and commit end with `Refs #4200`, which is correct for partial work. `Changelog: none` is correct.
- No process files, no snapshot PNGs, no `CHANGELOG.md`, no goldens and no `.github`, `scripts` or `build.rs` changes.
- This is a fork PR, so I keep it as the author set it. After the fix, push to the same branch and ask for a re-review.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a re-review. The fix commit `9a92fcf47` fixes the one requested change of the earlier review. All suites below pass.

Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4374#issuecomment-7222719640

## Earlier findings (review of `500d0a1bc`)

1. Requested: personal Windows path as the default of `rotor_step_profile_bench`. **Fixed** in `9a92fcf47`. `crates/kernel/tests/mesh_deviation_bench.rs` now uses `let Ok(path) = std::env::var("CAMCRAFT_ROTOR_STEP") else { ...; return; }`. The doc comment does not name a default. I ran the row with `--ignored` and no variable: it prints `rotor: skipped (set CAMCRAFT_ROTOR_STEP)`, 1 passed.

Optional items of the earlier review:

- Log level: **done**. All the new stage, progress and per-attempt lines are `tracing::debug!` now, in the kernel and in `crates/geometry/src/step.rs`. The app's default `info` filter does not print them. The bench sets `camcraft_kernel=debug` as its own fallback filter.
- `thread_local!` key: **done**. The key is the `&'static str` stage name, not its length.
- `Cargo.toml` comment: **done**. It names #163 and #4200.
- `crates/kernel/src/machining_mesh.rs` is 407 lines (limit about 400). Not changed. Not blocking. The #4200 fix can split it.

## Safety tier

The diff touches the STEP read and the machining mesh. The fix commit changes only the log level of events, one `thread_local!` key type, a comment and the test row. No control path, refusal or returned value changes. No goldens moved and the PR has no mutations, so I ran none. I ran all kernel and geometry suites and the app STEP suites again to show that the verdicts are unchanged.

## Results (locally, trial merge with upstream/main `2f766c307`)

The trial merge is clean. `HEAD^1` is `9a92fcf47`.

- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel`: all binaries pass, 0 failed. This includes lib 22, `machining_mesh` 7, `machining_mesh_bounds` 5, `machining_mesh_open` 6, `machining_mesh_parity` 7, `machining_mesh_redivide` 1, `machining_mesh_shortfalls` 3 (1 ignored), `step_agreement` 32, `step_import` 3, `step_edge_gap` 6, `step_twisted_flank` 3, `step_short_units` 20, `corrupt_input` 6, `solidcraft_import` 13 and `solidcraft_hostile` 4.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test mesh_deviation_bench rotor_step_profile_bench -- --ignored`: 1 passed (skip path).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry`: all binaries pass, 0 failed. This includes lib 77, `step_csys_read` 12, `step_diag` 5, `step_edge_gap` 4, `step_metre_unit` 1, `step_twisted_flank` 2 and `step_units` 6.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-kernel -p camcraft-geometry --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test step_agreement`: 32 passed.
- kernel `machining_mesh` suite: 7 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join`: 5 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test import_step_guard_default_cap --test import_step_open_shell --test step_nesting`: 1, 4 and 9 passed.

Heavy lanes: not run. No heavy record names this head. The diff adds no heavy logic. The only new ignored row skips without its file.

## Optional, non-blocking

- The first commit `500d0a1bc` still has the old path in its diff. A merge commit keeps that commit in the history of `main`. If the author wants the path out of the history too, the branch needs a new single commit. That is the author's choice. This review does not ask for it.

## Process

- Commit subjects are conventional. The body and both commits end with `Refs #4200`, which is correct for partial work. `Changelog: none` is correct.
- No process files, no snapshot PNGs, no `CHANGELOG.md`, no goldens, and no `.github`, `scripts` or `build.rs` changes. `Cargo.lock` adds two edges to packages that are already in the lock.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
